recognize_zh: 低倍免疫染色下，一個界線清楚的圓形淋巴結節呈細胞膜棕色陽性（推測為 B 細胞標記如 CD20），周圍骨髓只有零星陽性細胞，顯示這是骨髓內以 B 細胞為主的淋巴濾泡。
features: Single well-circumscribed round lymphoid nodule with dense membranous brown staining
Positive cells concentrated within the nodule; scattered positive cells in the surrounding interstitium
Nodule is intertrabecular rather than paratrabecular
describe_en: Bone marrow core biopsy immunohistochemical stain (marker not labeled; pattern suggests a B-cell marker such as CD20) at low power shows a single well-circumscribed, intertrabecular lymphoid nodule with dense membranous staining of its cells. Only scattered positive cells are present in the surrounding hematopoietic marrow. The circumscribed, non-paratrabecular B-cell nodule corresponds to the germinal center seen on H&E. Findings are consistent with a reactive B-cell follicle in the marrow; BCL2 and CD10 staining would help exclude follicular lymphoma.

ddx.vs: Follicular lymphoma aggregates are typically paratrabecular and show BCL2 co-expression in CD10-positive follicle center cells.
Marginal zone lymphoma often shows multiple aggregates with intrasinusoidal spread and light chain restriction in plasmacytic cells.
CLL nodules are CD5- and CD23-positive small B cells with proliferation centers, not a germinal center with mantle.
